Finding the Ticket Price Based on Age
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Read a person's age and print the ticket price for that age, using an if-else-if ladder.
Description
A museum charges Rs.50 for children aged 12 or below, Rs.100 for people aged 13 to 59, and Rs.70 for senior citizens aged 60 or above. Read an integer age from input and use an if-else-if ladder to find and print the ticket price.
Input Description
A single non-negative integer age.
Output Description
Print the ticket price.
Sample Input
25
Sample Output
100
